mcqs.keyword: GSI establishment and headquarters; Mud-volcano belts
mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II in the context of the Geological Survey of India and known mud-volcano belts.

List-I
(a) Year of GSI founding
(b) Ministry under which GSI functions
(c) GSI headquarters
(d) Mud-volcano belts mentioned in the context

List-II
(i) Kolkata
(ii) Azerbaijan, Sidoarjo and Makran
(iii) 1851
(iv) Ministry of Mines

Select the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: The correct matching is a-iii, b-iv, c-i and d-ii: GSI was founded in 1851, functions under the Ministry of Mines, and has its headquarters in Kolkata; Azerbaijan, Sidoarjo and Makran are other mud-volcano belts. The tempting alternative a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i incorrectly interchanges the year, ministry, headquarters and belt locations.

mcqs.question: According to Oil Change International’s “Planet Wreckers” report, by how much did global oil and gas output increase between 2015 and 2024?
options: 14 million barrels of oil equivalent per day
11 million barrels of oil equivalent per day
40 million barrels of oil equivalent per day
77 million barrels of oil equivalent per day
mcqs.explanation: Global oil and gas output increased by 14 million barrels of oil equivalent per day between 2015 and 2024, a rise of 40%. The figure of 11 million barrels of oil equivalent per day refers to the USA’s share of the net global increase, not the total increase.
